identity.fantasy: A voodoo puppeteer who layers curses and Shadow damage, stores part of that pain in Threads, then releases it through clones, spirits, and delayed detonations.
identity.one_line: A voodoo puppeteer who layers curses and Shadow damage, stores part of that pain in Threads, then releases it through clones, spirits, and delayed detonations. The defining decision is contextual: Target count, clone time, and mana decide between Malefic Wrath and Shadowflare.

mechanics.core_loop: A Shadow-heavy damage-over-time and delayed-burst caster. Puppeteer's Threads stores part of the damage you deal, while Bad Juju, Hexfire, Shadow Puppets, wards, golems, and spirit cooldowns build toward large detonation windows. Strong multi-target potential comes with setup, DoT tracking, and cooldown alignment.
mechanics.single_target: Apply Hex of Malice, summon Shadow Puppets, use Mimic and cooldowns, then Hexfire, Bad Juju, and Malefic Wrath while the clone window remains. This sequence is supported by one build and one brief community reply.
mechanics.aoe: At four or more targets, obtain the puppet buff and spam Shadowflare according to the captured guide. Players separately report slow setup and mana friction, so pack lifespan matters.
mechanics.movement_and_target_switching: Ranged kiting and slows help, but setup attached to enemies makes rapid target changes costly.
mechanics.defense_and_control: Its structural defensive package includes Shadow Puppets, Loa Spirits, Bad Juju, Puppeteer's Grasp, Beware Da Voodoo.
mechanics.group_utility: Group or control tools include Puppeteer's Grasp, Hollow Spirit, Malignant Jinx, Dark Loa's Blessing, Soul Marionette.

failure_modes.text: Detonating or channeling before curses and stored damage mature, losing the puppet window, or spending mana on short-lived packs collapses the delayed payoff.
Starting Malefic Wrath after the puppet or clone window expires channels into a missing multiplier.
Using the four-target Shadowflare plan on a short-lived pack can consume mana before setup pays back.
